name: routing-data-is-never-a-fallback
why: The most valuable negative in this category. With no type but a perfectly good exchange and routing key available, an implementer will be tempted to fall back to them. ADR-011 rejects exactly that: routing keys are high-cardinality and dynamic, alternate and dead-letter bindings rewrite them in flight, and the consumer cannot see them. An SDK that quietly falls back produces subjects no other SDK produces.
